outcome: Maternal adverse outcomes (e.g., premature births, abortions)
cohort: Pregnant women diagnosed with hypothyroidism admitted to a tertiary hospital between October 1, 2020, and December 31, 2022.
finding: The developed risk prediction model, incorporating nine variables, effectively predicts the probability of both maternal and neonatal adverse outcomes in pregnant women with hypothyroidism, aiding clinicians in identifying high-risk cases.
